output.summary: Perennial grass native to tropical and subtropical Asia, Micronesia, Melanesia, Australia, Africa and southern Europe, cogon grass forms dense stands linked by extensive underground stems. Its sharp-pointed, finely toothed leaves have an off-centre pale main vein, and it is highly flammable even when apparently green.
output.edibilityNote: Young flower clusters and shoots may be eaten cooked; the roots contain starch and sugars.
